description: KYC flow update (Task 5). Once a client submits KYC, show a 'KYC Pending' UI state instead of the blank intake form. The logic should check KYC status on the dashboard and redirect accordingly.
steps: In healthcamp-client/src/Home.tsx, the existing modal already checks kycData?.kyc?.kycStatus !== 'approved' and shows a modal prompting to fill KYC. Modify the modal behavior: if kycStatus is 'pending', the modal should show 'Your KYC is pending approval' with a button to view KYC details (navigate to /kyc-details) instead of the current 'Click here to fill up the KYC' button that goes to /kycstatus.

In healthcamp-client/src/pages/kyc/KycStatus.tsx, the page already handles the display of KYC status. The 'Initiate KYC Verification' button is already disabled when kycStatus is 'pending' or 'approved'. Ensure this continues working correctly.

The key fix: In Home.tsx, differentiate between three KYC states in the modal: (a) kycStatus is null/undefined - show 'Please fill KYC' with link to /kycstatus, (b) kycStatus is 'pending' - show 'KYC Pending Approval' message with link to /kyc-details, (c) kycStatus is 'reject' - show 'KYC was rejected' with link to /kycstatus to re-initiate.

Additionally, check the KycApprove.tsx page (the actual KYC form at /kyc route). Add a guard at the top of this component: if the user already has KYC data with status 'pending' or 'approved', redirect them away from the form (navigate to /kyc-details or /kycstatus) so they cannot access the blank form again.
acceptance_criteria: User with kycStatus=null sees modal prompting to fill KYC form
User with kycStatus='pending' sees modal showing 'KYC Pending' state with link to view status
User with kycStatus='reject' sees modal with rejection info and link to re-initiate
User with kycStatus='approved' does not see any KYC modal
Navigating to /kyc route when kycStatus is 'pending' or 'approved' redirects away from the blank form
The KycApprove form page is not accessible once KYC has been submitted
verification: Run npx tsc --noEmit in healthcamp-client directory to verify no TypeScript errors
findings: Implementation straightforward. The kycStatus field can be null/undefined, 'pending', 'approved', or 'reject'. The modal in Home.tsx now renders different content for each non-approved state. The KycApprove form page now redirects to /kyc-details if kycStatus is pending or approved. Post-review fix: added early return (return null) before rendering the form when kycStatus is pending or approved to prevent flash-of-content before the useEffect redirect fires.
